claim: Every room-over-room stack takes two of the 128 mirror slots (one for the floor, one for the ceiling), after the wall mirrors; stacks stop being prepared at 127. A map with wall mirrors must leave at least 2 sectors and 5 walls free under the limits (the test is numsectors + 1 >= kMaxSectors or numwalls + 4 >= kMaxWalls, though its message says 1 and 4) or every wall mirror is cancelled.
evidence: mirrors.cpp:492-533 (two mirror entries per linked floor/ceiling pair)
use: Count stacks and mirror walls together against 128; keep sector and wall headroom when a map has a mirror.
